news_candidates.title: Where Bond Yields Are Heading as Energy Prices Rise
news_candidates.title_zh: 能源价格上涨之际，债券收益率将走向何方
news_candidates.summary: Highlights from Bloomberg TV as contributors shed light on how rising energy prices are driving bond yields higher across markets and traders reposition in anticipation of further challenges. Meanwhile, the yield on 30-year US government bonds have climbed back to levels seen just before Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent expanded a buyback program to contain long-term borrowing costs. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: 彭博电视嘉宾讨论能源价格上涨如何推动各市场债券收益率走高，以及交易员如何为更多挑战调整仓位。美国30年期国债收益率已回升至财政部长斯科特·贝森特扩大回购计划以抑制长期借贷成本前的水平。

news_candidates.title: RBNZ Delivers Back-to-Back Rate Hikes to Curb Inflation
news_candidates.title_zh: 新西兰联储连续第二次加息以遏制通胀
news_candidates.summary: New Zealand’s central bank raised its key interest rate for a second straight meeting, aiming to shift to less stimulatory settings in an effort to head off inflationary pressures.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 新西兰央行连续第二次会议上调关键利率，旨在转向刺激性较弱的政策立场，以防范通胀压力。

news_candidates.title: Launch Site and Facility Progress ahead of East Coast Starship debut

news_candidates.title: BOJ Board Hawk Calls for Nimble Hikes to Prevent Price Risks

news_candidates.summary: Bank of Japan Board Member Hajime Takata, one of the bank’s most hawkish members, reiterated his call for nimble interest rate hikes to prevent upward price deviations, adding to growing speculation over a near-term policy move.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 日本央行最鹰派的委员之一高田创重申，应灵活上调利率以防止物价上行偏离，进一步加剧了市场对近期政策行动的猜测。

news_candidates.title: Australia’s Faster Economic Growth Bolsters Rate-Hike Case
news_candidates.title_zh: 澳大利亚经济加速增长强化加息理由

news_candidates.summary_zh: 澳大利亚上季度经济增长意外加快，为澳洲联储再次加息以抑制顽固高通胀提供更多依据。

news_candidates.title: Apple follows Google in adopting Trump’s ‘Lake America’ name

news_candidates.title: Copper’s Rally Stalls as Worries About Global Economy Resurface

news_candidates.summary: Copper fell for a second day, dropping with other metals, as resurgent oil prices fanned concerns about prospects for the world economy.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 铜价连续第二天下跌，并带动其他金属走低；油价再度上涨加剧了对全球经济前景的担忧。

news_candidates.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it

news_candidates.title: Bessent Says China Prevented G20 Communique Over Imbalance Spat

news_candidates.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said China prevented the Group of 20 from issuing a joint communique after a gathering of finance and central bank chiefs this week due to a dispute over its giant trade surplus.

news_candidates.title: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B

news_candidates.summary_zh: 据报道，AI模型训练初创公司AfterQuery完成新一轮融资，估值达32亿美元。该公司5个月前宣布以3亿美元估值完成3000万美元A轮融资。

news_candidates.title: China Bond Sales Set to Accelerate, Putting Focus on PBOC

news_candidates.summary_zh: 为提振低迷经济，中国政府债券发行在短暂停滞后预计将加快。发行增加可能促使央行注入更多流动性。

news_candidates.title: S. Korea’s Inflation Picks Up on One-Off Phone Bill Effect

news_candidates.title: Amazon Alexa can now alert you when something new might tempt you to shop

news_candidates.title: Iran attacks US bases in Middle East after reports US strike killed five at wedding party

news_candidates.title: Israel Cuts Interest Rates for Third Consecutive Meeting
